column6: notes_compiler_ir.md 5.1: *(program+8) is the Compiler, +0x3a0 the entry block, +0x384 the block list; this IL-to-IR translator builds Entry/Exit blocks around it (see its caller in part_024)

state of the IL token decoder: FUN_000e5e70(param_2) decodes the next IL instruction into it (opcode at +0x8e via FUN_000e4408, register byte +0x8d, token words from +0x8c, operand arrays [0x19]/[0x1b])
the Block that translated instructions are appended to (FUN_000f92fc(program, inst, local_180)); replaced by each newly created and connected block
the block before currentBlock: Block__connect(local_184, new) then local_184 = new
stack (vector header: capacity, count, data) pushed with the IfHeader created for if/ifc/ifnz, read by else (0x27) and popped by endif (0x29)
stack of 3-word records {condition register, use count, 0} pushed at case 0x72 and read at 0x6f when the IfHeader condition is built
